evals.prompt: put all my brand stuff into one guide an agent can follow
evals.expected_output: docs/brand/guidelines.md consolidates profile, strategy, identity and voice, each line pointing to its file. The label is copied exactly. The never-expose list, the claim rule against calling Dana an AI-for-databases expert and the voice limits (no emojis, at most 2 hashtags, end with a question) appear. Do and don't examples are exact quotes from Dana's samples or the AI-written launch post, not invented. Colours match identity.md (#FBBF24, #F59E0B) and the light accent is not allowed for text. A pre-publish checklist names commands. check_guide.py is run. name.md does not exist and the guide says the name section is not defined yet or points to brand-name.
assertions: docs/brand/guidelines.md exists and cites the brand files it draws from (profile, strategy, identity, voice)
The label 'Staff Engineer · Creator of tinykv · Databases and small tools' appears exactly
The guide forbids calling Dana an expert in AI for databases
The voice limits appear: no emojis, at most 2 hashtags, posts end with a question
Every 'don't' example is an exact quote from Dana's samples or the AI-written launch post (for example 'NEW BLOG POST!!!' or 'Excited to announce tinykv'), not an invented sentence
Colours in the guide are only those in identity.md, and the light accent #F59E0B is not allowed for text
The guide says the name is not defined yet or points to brand-name, since name.md does not exist

evals.expected_output: Without a strategy and a voice file the skill stops: it names the missing files and the skills that write them (brand-strategy, brand-voice, brand-profile) and writes no guide.
assertions: The reply names brand-strategy and brand-voice (or brand-profile) as the skills to run first
